statements.text: Part Q should show starch, because it received carbon dioxide from air with water and sunlight.
Part P should not show starch, because it could not get carbon dioxide from air.
Part P should show starch, because water and sunlight alone are enough without carbon dioxide.

stem:
Kalyani sets up a half-leaf bottle experiment on a destarched green leaf. Part P of the leaf is enclosed so it cannot get carbon dioxide from air. Part Q stays in open air with carbon dioxide. Both parts get water and sunlight. She later tests both parts for starch with iodine.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Carbon dioxide from air is essential for starch preparation. The open half (Q) can form starch; the enclosed half (P) without carbon dioxide should not.
